ModMetaData.name: Interaction Bubbles Expanded
ModMetaData.author: Vengie
ModMetaData.description:
Interaction Bubbles Expanded for RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7.
Interaction Bubbles ported to 1.7 with QOL features: - Color Coded Bubbles! A red bubble means that they are causing a bad mood and green means they are causing a good mood. Neutral will be default just like the OG mod. - Ported to 1.7 - Added debug actions to make testing the mod easier. - Added additional conversation phrases etc - You can now click on a bubble to open up the social tab of that pawn.
More changes are to come!
Original Mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1516158345
Original description: Wouldn't it be great if you could read character interactions? Well you can, in the social log... or with
Interaction Bubbles
Shows bubbles when characters perform a social interaction with the text that would normally only be found in the log. This allows you to watch Tynan's wonderful interaction system in action as you go about your business without having to open up a tab.
Bubbles will fade away after a short time but they are linked to the game time so pausing the game will halt the bubble from fading. Hovering over a bubble will make it nearly transparent and they can be clicked through to objects underneath. There is a toggle button in the play settings area to disable bubbles from being shown.
Requires Harmony.
Based on Interaction Bubbles by Jaxe. Expanded and maintained by Vengie.
